newsitem.title: USA: Primark Corp to acquire WEFA in cash deal.
newsitem.headline: Primark Corp to acquire WEFA in cash deal.

text.p: Primark Corp said Thursday it entered an agreement to acquire WEFA Holdings Inc from Bain Capital Inc and certain other shareholders in a $45 million cash transaction.

Primark said in a release that the acquisition of WEFA, an international provider of value-added economic information, software and consulting services, is expected to close within the next thirty days.
WEFA reported revenues of about $29 million in 1996, Primark said.
The acquisition is expected to be accretive to Primark's earnings and cash flow during 1997.
